Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_key as compound_key, docs.pubmed_id as pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description as assay_description, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.activity_comment, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, target_dictionary.organism as target_organism
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Join activities on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.bao_endpoint = 'BAO_0000006' and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and activities.activity_comment is not null
Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and assays.tid = 4805
Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Join compound_records on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Join docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4805' and (docs.pubmed_id is not null or docs.doi is not null)
Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Limit 2000
